q: How do I find a CBAM accredited verifier?
title: Finding a CBAM accredited verifier
short: Check the verifier's accreditation certificate from an EU national accreditation body, covering your sector. The European cooperation for Accreditation lists bodies offering CBAM accreditation, the Commission plans to publish a list of accredited verifiers, and the CBAM Registry will let you search for one.
audience: Indian installation operators choosing a CBAM verifier

ul: Accreditation from an EU national accreditation body, valid when the final report is issued.
Scope covering your sector, such as iron and steel or cement.

p: Verification companies established outside the EU may apply for accreditation with any national accreditation body that offers it.

senseible: Senseible keeps the invoices behind each fuel and electricity figure in one fingerprinted record, so a verifier can sample them without a hunt through files. Senseible is not a CBAM verifier and does not issue verification reports.
